items.reason: Gap 0 names two concurrent deliveries of the same event both passing the Set check before either records the id.
Gap 1 describes an altered unsigned X-Event-Id on a signed body causing deduplication under the wrong identity.

No gap depends on multiple processes, instances, or replicas.
